title: Osakeyhtiölaki 6 luku 6 § (hallituksen pöytäkirja) and 5 luku 23 § (yhtiökokouksen pöytäkirja)
source: Osakeyhtiölaki 624/2006, consolidated through 652/2024 (Finlex open data, dateConsolidated 2025-06-27). Read 2026-10-09.

rules.text: Minutes are drawn up for every board meeting, signed by the chair and, when the board has several members, at least one member the board picks.
Board members and the managing director may have a dissent recorded in the minutes.
The minutes are numbered in sequence and kept reliably.
At a general meeting the chair has a voting list (ääniluettelo) made and put in or attached to the minutes, which record the decisions and the votes.
The chair and one minutes checker the meeting elects sign the general meeting's minutes.
The general meeting's minutes are available to the shareholders within two weeks.
